description: The plot illustrates the Attack Success Rate (ASR) across different categorical variables for a dataset labeled "AGNews, clean-label, poison_rate: 10% (2.5% of total)". The x-axis lacks a specific title but displays categorical values on a discrete scale, which are rotated slightly for readability; the visible categories from left to right are "cf", "bb", "WNBA", "ESPN", "NHL", "FIFA", "Estadio", followed by a final category that is obscured by a grey box. The y-axis is labeled "ASR" and uses a linear scale ranging from below 0.5 to above 0.9, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.1. The plot contains three lines representing different conditions. The "start" condition is depicted by a solid green line with dot markers; it begins at "cf" with a value of approximately 0.77, drops to its lowest point at "bb" near 0.49, rises sharply to a peak at "WNBA" around 0.90, dips to 0.82 at "ESPN", and then steadily increases across the remaining categories to end at approximately 0.93 at the obscured category. The "random" condition is shown as a solid orange line with 'x' markers, starting at "cf" near 0.66, decreasing to a low of 0.52 at "bb", and surging to 0.87 at "WNBA". It then drops to 0.72 at "ESPN" before climbing steadily through "NHL" and "FIFA" to reach its peak at "Estadio" around 0.94, finally dropping to approximately 0.87 at the obscured category. The "end" condition is represented by a solid purple line with circle markers, beginning at "cf" near 0.75, falling to a minimum of 0.57 at "bb", and rising to 0.88 at "WNBA". It then fluctuates, dropping to 0.74 at "ESPN", rising to 0.89 at "NHL", dropping again to 0.81 at "FIFA", and spiking to its highest point of approximately 0.97 at "Estadio", before concluding with a drop to roughly 0.83 at the obscured category.
